subject: Flash & Encord - next chapter in AI Vision
text:
Hi [NAME],

Powerfleet's transformation under your leadership was remarkable - you took
it from a hardware-focused company to a data-centric SaaS powerhouse.
Reaching out since we work w/ Flock Safety, Woven by Toyota, Automotus and
many computer vision teams in mobility to accelerate their iterations.
Would love to hear how you're thinking about expanding Flash Vision's
capabilities in your new role, if you have 15 mins to chat?

At Encord (90+ employees, $50M+ raised), we help advanced computer vision
and multimodal AI teams to stay on top of large-scale image/video data
curation & annotation for model training. Teams working on LPR and vehicle
detection algorithms (Flock Safety, UVeye, Tractable, etc.) use us to
improve model accuracy and reliability.

Flash has been on my radar since the FVR-MARK4 release. Would love to
connect if you're open for a quick call this week or the next? Wednesdays /
Thursdays work for me - happy to work around your schedule.

subject: Encord & [COMPANY] - Intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the recent raise! Thought I'd reach out since we recently
started working with Skydio & Zipline on developing very similar perception
models with the goal of speeding up their expansion into new autonomous
drone use cases.

We're mostly assisting with improving model quality / delivery speed while
keeping development costs low as they scale through better end-to-end data
mgmt and by allowing them to curate/annotate high resolution videos
natively on our platform.

Not sure how familiar you are with Encord, we're an SF-based data
development platform built for advanced computer vision and multimodal AI
teams to build better models (~5 years old, 70+ employees & raised $50M+
funding).

We've been following [COMPANY] for a while now and would love to get your
candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord if you have 30mins to
chat. Open to a quick call this week or the next? Wednesdays / Thursdays
work best for me, however very happy to work around your schedule.
